entry.note: Stakes: mine country of its own (a Sabotage plan in remote sprawl at the colony's size, its installation a cantonment) with the Surveyor down in it, bow west (long-survey-maps.md, Chapter 2); three stakes planted in a line across the hull's south flank, each linked straight to the hull, and one raised beyond them among the outcrops, the first zone the company fights through from the south edge
